review.official:
Sakiko Togawa is the keyboardist of
Ave Mujica
. She lodges aboard
Rhodes Island
together with the rest of the band, and actively takes on tasks of all manner aboard the ship. Her musical training and dignified manner are incontrovertible proof of her excellent upbringing.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Sakiko Togawa shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

We took in the five members of Ave Mujica at Iris's request, her wish being that we provide them temporary refuge. Given their youth and how they were stranded somewhere unfamiliar so far from home, we communicated our intent that they get some much-needed rest. However, all of them expressed that they would rather help us in exchange for their room and board, and Sakiko in particular made clear her strong desire to undertake any and all work here.

Sakiko is an active participant in a variety of work aboard the landship. Normally dignified and elegant, she shows no qualms about taking up simple communications assignments or manual labor tasks such as cleaning and transporting items; she carries out all her jobs without complaint. It is as though she already had a fair amount of experience with such work before coming to Rhodes Island. During work, she is always sunny and positive, while also showing care and concern for those around her. Her kind smile has left a deep impression on many operators.

Sakiko came to Rhodes Island from the Castle of Dreams, and is almost never seen without the other members of Ave Mujica. The five of them, each thinking in different ways and pursuing different things, have been able to come together as a single band and work towards the same goal because of Sakiko.
Sakiko makes mistakes too, of course, but her strength is the ability to make decisions without fear. There would be no Ave Mujica without Sakiko's gentle strength.

From the information we have, Sakiko was brought up in high society and received an excellent education from a young age, growing into a kind and affable young lady as a result. She formed her own band in emulation of a group of senior students who left a deep impression on her. Then misfortune struck; her father was forced to take the blame and resign after his company fell victim to fraud, and Sakiko was forced to quit her beloved band and work part-time odd jobs to support her broken household thereafter.
Strong-minded and refusing to give up, Sakiko would not let others see her weakness, and formed Ave Mujica in order to cut ties with her past. In spite of this, the new band was not as smooth a venture as Sakiko envisioned, and conflict arose between an inflexible Sakiko and the other band members, who would not open themselves up to her. Through all the turmoil, however, Sakiko was surely the one most mired in suffering, squarely blaming herself and proceeding to repeat her past mistakes.
All that said, Sakiko has seemed somewhat changed from that in her time aboard Rhodes Island. One wonders if she owes it to her experiences at the Castle of Dreams.

[Iris's Notes]
Sakiko is kind-hearted and forward-facing, cares deeply for her friends, and takes it upon herself to grapple with whatever faces her. As a result, however, she has a tendency to lose sight of what is happening around her, and in so doing, hurt her friends unawares.
Sakiko's conviction in her own decisions is firm. In her mind, she must bear the weight of the other members' lives on her shoulders, and running from this responsibility is not an option.
This is something far, far harder than she imagines it might be.
She can still be immature in places; she can still be weak and fearful, anxious that her decisions might hurt others. Moreover, she still harbors doubts that she truly can shoulder her bandmates' lives.
In the Castle of Dreams, Sakiko finally learned to believe in her own ability to fulfill her promises, but one must eventually wake up no matter how sweet the dream; she must come face to face with reality.
Sakiko will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and goes back to her old life. But I believe that a part of her experiences in the dream will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage for her to overcome all challenges, and continue to carry Ave Mujica atop her shoulders.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your decision-making acumen is a great inspiration. Would you permit me to observe you for a while longer?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: As a work institute, Rhodes Island is just outstanding. Strict yet flexible scheduling, rational evaluation criteria, a clear promotion track... Where did I learn to see things this way, you ask? Well, my... relations are quite versed in the field.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You don't need to tell me―this is a 'soda fountain', isn't it? When you mix different drinks together, you can get surprisingly refreshing results, you know.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: We as band members do have disputes from time to time, but it's all in service of raising the band to greater heights. Ave Mujica is unshakable, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Memories of dreams all fade away someday, don't they... Don't be mistaken, Doctor. I don't rue the fact for one moment. I know full well it was a life I never could have had in the first place... The chance to at least dream such a beautiful dream is more than enough for me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I owe it to the days I've spent on Rhodes Island for reshaping my outlook on Terra. This vast land is filled with people living cruel realities that far surpass the imagination... I have a new resolve to see if I can reach these people, with songs that might nestle in their hearts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I had a dream, before I came to Rhodes Island even, that we were all living here, working here. I can recall it so vividly even now, as clear as any memory... Hence, when I greeted Vigna-san with a 'Nice to meet you', I couldn't help but feel a twinge of estrangement. *chuckle* Do keep this strictly between us, please?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, this is that 'bridge' I was telling you so much about! Here, you can shout everything that's on your mind out loud, and it feels amazing. I'll demonstrate for you first, so would you mind following my lead after? Here I go―

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oh, this doll? I received it from Bena-san. *chuckle* When I place it by my side, I feel this sort of warmth cozying up inside me, somewhere near and dear to me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can't forget how necessary rest is to improving results. During the fledgling days of Ave Mujica's formation, I'd often stay up working throughout the night. But Uika gave me a talking-to, and that was how I finally learned my lesson. *chuckle* 'It's not good for your health!' Her words.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Oblivionis of Ave Mujica, Sakiko Togawa. Until we find a way back, I would be much obliged.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are our everyday activities going to be recorded on video too?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Compared to the other squad captains, I have a great deal I must learn still... I will henceforth devote my utmost efforts to keeping pace with you all.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: To be given recognition comes hand in hand with greater responsibility. However, I am of course prepared for that.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: It is time for our teamwork to be put to the test.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will spearhead my members and see our mission through, as I ever do. It is as simple as that.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now, let's begin... tonight's masquerade!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: How bothersome...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm sure you and I are drawing up the same plans right now, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, your decision please.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Time will not wait for us.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I have no time to waste on feeling lost.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The doll takes on a temporal life.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The moon will press closer and closer on you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Even so, will you still seek solace?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: In this twilight paradise, I will continue to reign!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I must commend you on your show of tactics just now... Was this victory just one more surprise, courtesy of you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a spectacular battle—well done to all of you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Just a little more...!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I... hate myself.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a sanitary workplace. Its constant maintenance is all but evident.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Kyah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Might I be of assistance in any way?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I happened to be in the training grounds this whole time, and only realized it was past midnight once I heard the cheering coming from outside... Allow me to give you my first greetings of the year, then—a very Happy New Year to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor. There is to be a masquerade tonight. Do come if time permits. We have a special seat waiting for you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: 'Happy birthday to you'... I was taught this song when I was still young. In the days after I'd learned it, I would keep playing it every day to my heart's content... I may have perturbed Mother somewhat with that.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm honored I could greet this special day together with you. Since the moment we first arrived, the sight of us all striving for the same goal has done wonders for the spirit.
